{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if sentiment turns negative (e.g., sentiment < 0.00) and price is trending upward.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 5-day average, reduce by 5-15% for next period.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment is negative and historical price is trending downward.",
    "Avoid overreacting to short-term sentiment shifts; lag corrections by 1-2 periods for sentiment-driven volatility.",
    "If sentiment is positive but price is falling, reduce forecast by 5-10% to avoid overcorrection.",
    "For long-term forecasts (30d), apply smoothing: if true outcome deviates >10% from 30d moving average, adjust forecast toward average."
  ]
}
